budgetNote: GA-05 absolute latency budget: the p95 over the iterations of the wall time provenance ADDED to the same iteration's provenance-disabled scan (cold: empty cache; warm: cache hit) must stay under budgetMs.coldAddedP95 and budgetMs.warmAddedP95. The budget is frozen in runner.mjs with its derivation and is not read from this file; the measured addedMs distributions are recorded here so a reader can see the headroom. Checked beside the ratio gates.
note: Wall-clock and peak-RSS overhead of provenance annotation vs. a provenance-disabled scan, on a synthetic 15-file/3-commit-each git fixture. cold = fresh provenance cache; warm = second with-provenance pass against the same fixture/HEAD, so the on-disk provenance cache is hit. Each dimension is a distribution over n=60 iterations (nearest-rank percentiles, matching posture/fix-metrics.js's convention); the gated number is the p95 of the per-iteration ratio, not a single sample. GATED: cold.timeOverheadRatio, warm.timeOverheadRatio, cold.memOverheadRatio, each at a plain 1.6x-of-baseline-p95 limit (no additive margin — Task 8 removed it once repeated real runs showed cold memory ratio holds within ~12% of its own baseline, so a pure multiplicative factor is already wide enough to avoid noise-only failures while still catching a genuine ~2x regression). NOT GATED: warm.memOverheadRatio — still measured and recorded every run, but its own run-to-run noise (observed 0x-5x+ on an unchanged engine, because the warm arm's scan is tens of ms and its ratio denominator sits at or near the sampler's floor) makes it unfalsifiable at this fixture size; a gate that cannot fail advertises coverage it does not have, so it is honestly excluded instead of padded with a margin wide enough to never trip. Every checkDim'd dimension also requires `reliable: true` (n >= 10) — an unreliable sample size fails the gate rather than silently comparing too few points. See runner.mjs for the full reasoning (Task 6 review; Task 8 fix).
